result_text:
I fixed the "past 90d" block so it shows the main LOC of the repositories with commits in the past 90 days. I didn't compile it or run any tests.

The block was passing `loc180Days` to the displayed LOC text. It now passes `loc90Days`, which was already being computed and used for the percentage. The change is one line in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`.
